CanBeGeneratedInCombat.maps_to: NOT PORTED -- the shared `_ChoosableCurse` base sets `can_be_generated_by_modifiers = False` instead (knowledge_curses.py:26)
CanBeGeneratedInCombat.issue: `public override bool CanBeGeneratedInCombat => false` (WasteAway.cs:15) has no counterpart; the sim leaves `can_be_generated_in_combat` True and turns off a different flag that WasteAway.cs does not override (C# leaves it `=> true`, CardModel.cs:648). Two mismatched flags in one card, and the FOURTH and last instance of this exact error -- card/disintegration, card/mind_rot, card/sloth and this one all share the `_ChoosableCurse` base, so one base-class fix corrects all four. Same verdict throughout (rule 3). DORMANT both ways: `pool_card_ids()` (IRONCLAD_POOL) holds no Status cards and the random-CURSE pool holds no Status-rarity cards.

ctor.issue: STATUS / STATUS / NONE map exactly. The canonical energy cost is -1 in C# and 0 in the sim. `CardEnergyCost.GetWithModifiers` returns early on `_base < 0` (CardEnergyCost.cs:100-103), so the game's unplayable card is immune to every cost modifier; the sim runs a base of 0 through the full modifier chain (cards/base.py:222-232). Only what is READ diverges. Same mechanism and same verdict as card/ascenders_bane's ctor entry (rule 3). DORMANT: every ported cost reader filters `> 0` or skips `<= 1`, and events/infested_automaton.py:35 filters pool_card_ids(), which holds no curses or statuses.

CanonicalVars.rationale: `new PowerVar<WasteAwayPower>(1m)` (WasteAway.cs:21) == `default_power_amount = 1`, copied into `self.power_amount` by `_init_vars` so it is re-seeded on downgrade. The amount is an ENERGY REDUCTION per turn, not a stack count.

OnChosen.maps_to: _ChoosableCurse's power application via CombatState.select_cards (knowledge_curses.py module docstring; the chooser is the Knowledge Demon)
OnChosen.rationale: `PowerCmd.Apply<WasteAwayPower>(new ThrowingPlayerChoiceContext(), Owner.Creature, DynamicVars["WasteAwayPower"].IntValue, Owner.Creature, this)` (WasteAway.cs:28-31) == the sim's select-then-apply path reading `power_cls` and `power_amount` off the chosen card. Self-target, self-applier, amount 1. `KnowledgeDemon.IChoosable` is an interface rather than a CardModel override, so the harness's `public override` scan does not enumerate it -- added by hand. Presentation, folded in: the energy hover tip (19).

guards.what: the sim marks the card `is_playable = False` (knowledge_curses.py:23); WasteAway.cs declares NO Unplayable keyword
guards.issue: C# gives this Status no CanonicalKeywords at all, so in the game it is a PLAYABLE no-effect Status -- the shape card/beckon, card/slimed, card/toxic and card/spore_mind all have and the sim does model as playable. Same mechanism and same verdict as card/disintegration's, card/mind_rot's and card/sloth's guards (rule 3). DORMANT: the four Knowledge-Demon cards never reach a combat pile on either side, because the demon shows them on a choose-a-card screen and applies the chosen one's power directly.
